quantityDefinition: beta_ij=A_ij/sum_k(A_ik), with denominator scope stated. Direct first-emission fractions only.

rounding.normalizationRecommendation: Preserve reported values and source uncertainty; do not silently renormalize three triplet channels and erase the 1P1 branch.

matrixElement.convention: electronic J-reduced Racah-Wigner length gauge absolute magnitude; Porsev Eq2/TableI

conditions.isotopeApplicability: electronic J model adopted for 171Yb with explicit conditions; not isotope-specific F/mF experiment
conditions.finalStateSum: sum final hyperfine/Zeeman states and photon modes; neglect small hyperfine frequency differences

records.normalizationScope: J-resolved low-state spontaneous E1 model. Four 6s6p odd fine-structure final states were considered by Porsev; not experimentally demonstrated all-atomic-state/all-multipole completeness. Do not substitute for F,mF,B/polarization/cavity/BBR-specific branching.
